title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Commencement of Cover and the Waiting Period
content:
Cover under a Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan does not begin on the day of application. It begins once
the plan's waiting period has run, counted in whole calendar days from the day the subscription was
accepted, with the day of acceptance itself not counted, and a breakdown during the waiting period is
not attended under the plan.

### How the period is counted and what settles it

The clock is anchored on the day the subscription was accepted, and that day is not itself counted, so
counting opens on the day after acceptance. The comparison is not-earlier-than: cover may begin on the
day on which the last of the plan's waiting-period calendar days falls, and not before. The days are
whole calendar days.

What the subscription's own record shows settles the point — its reference number, the date its term
runs from and the state it stands in — and it is that record, rather than the member's account of when
they applied, that carries authority. The record consulted is the record of the subscription cover is
being asked to begin on, and the question is settled before cover begins.

### Boundary cases

| The day in question | Has the waiting period run |
| --- | --- |
| The day of acceptance, on a plan whose waiting period is more than 0 calendar days | No; that day is not counted at all |
| The day before the last of the plan's waiting-period days | No; a breakdown that day is not attended under the plan |
| The day on which the last of the plan's waiting-period days falls | Yes; cover may begin |
| The day of acceptance, on a plan whose waiting period stands at 0 calendar days | Yes; no day falls to be counted, so the period has run on the day of acceptance itself |

### The fee and the allowance

The plan may be paid monthly or for the year up front, and a member who pays for the year gets the
whole term's allowance at once rather than a twelfth of it each month.

The activation fee, where the plan charges one, falls due when cover begins and is not returned if the
member cancels inside the minimum term.
